full_prompt_en: A square color portrait photograph shows a young woman with round glasses turned partly away from the camera amid blurred city lights at night. The background is deliberately out of focus, filled with vertical turquoise and cream light bars and scattered amber, coral, and blue circles. Some luminous disks drift across the foreground as well, partially veiling her shoulder and the edges of her hair. The woman stands slightly left of center, with her body angled to the right and her head turned back toward the viewer. Loose blond strands fall around a calm, slightly distant face; her lips are parted and her gaze passes through thin metal-rimmed glasses. Tiny cyan reflections multiply in both lenses, making the eyes the sharpest and most arresting detail. A dark blue jacket fills the lower left and falls into shadow, its seams and fabric texture only faintly visible. Warm orange light catches the hair along the right side of her head and runs down the long strands, while cooler blue light brushes the left shoulder. The face sits between these opposed colors, modeled softly instead of sharply separated into bright and dark halves. At the top and far sides, deep indigo gaps keep the abundant blurred lights from becoming an even field. The shallow depth of field turns distant lamps into broad overlapping bokeh, with some bright circles almost white at the center and saturated at their fringes. The lighting is mixed and urban, with warm backlight and cool frontal reflections rather than a single hard beam. The overall composition anchors a quiet, readable portrait inside restless blue and amber light, giving an ordinary nighttime moment a dreamy atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形彩色肖像照片呈现一位戴圆眼镜的年轻女子，在夜晚模糊的城市灯光中半背对相机。背景有意失焦，充满竖向青绿色与奶油色光柱，以及散落的琥珀、珊瑚和蓝色圆斑。部分发亮圆斑也漂浮在前景，局部遮住她的肩部和发丝边缘。女子略站在中央左侧，身体朝右，头却转回看向观者。松散的金发围住平静而稍显疏离的脸；嘴唇微张，目光透过纤细金属圆镜框。双镜片里有许多细小青蓝色倒影，使眼睛成为最清晰、最引人注意的细部。深蓝夹克占据左下方并沉入阴影，衣缝与布料肌理仅隐约可见。暖橙光照亮头部右侧的发缘，沿长发向下流淌；较冷的蓝光掠过左肩。脸处于两种相对色彩之间，被柔和塑形，而非生硬分成明暗两半。画面顶部与两侧的深靛蓝空隙让繁多虚化灯点不至于成为均匀色场。浅景深把远处灯具化作宽大重叠的散景光斑，一些亮斑中心近白，边缘仍有饱和色彩。光线来自混合的城市光源，以暖色逆光与冷色正面反射为主，而非单一硬光束。整体构图把安静清晰的肖像稳在躁动的蓝琥珀光里，使普通夜晚一刻有梦幻气氛。
style_prompt_en: The photograph has shallow focus and abundant circular bokeh, with a small crisp focal region surrounded by broad, overlapping pools of light. Electric cyan and deep indigo contrast with amber, peach, and coral; near-white highlights punctuate the transition. Warm backlight outlines selected edges, while cooler reflected light supplies delicate detail in the center. Dark passages remain between the bright circles, preventing the saturated palette from flattening into a solid glow. Foreground blur partly overlaps the focal form, adding depth and a soft sense of visual interruption. The overall treatment is intimate and dreamy, with optical light effects carrying as much presence as the central shape.
style_prompt_zh: 照片以浅景深和大量圆形散景为特征，小片清晰焦点被宽阔重叠的光池包围。电青色和深靛蓝与琥珀、桃色、珊瑚色相对，近白高光点在其过渡间。暖色逆光描亮选定边缘，较冷的反射光为中心提供细腻细节。亮圆之间仍保留深暗区域，使饱和配色不至于压平为整片光亮。前景虚化部分叠在焦点形体上，增加纵深和轻柔的视觉遮断感。整体处理亲密而梦幻，光学光效与中央形体同样有存在感。
theme_en: A young woman with round glasses among luminous city lights
theme_zh: 一位戴圆眼镜的年轻女子置身发亮的城市灯光中
name: 梦幻霓虹散景人像
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
